text:
🗳️ Election update: half of all voting districts are now counted (11,878 of 23,696). All figures are provisional.

National (proportional ballot): ANC 32.1%, DA 26.4%, MK 7.7%, EFF 5.9%, ActionSA 4.3%, IFP 3.8%. Turnout is about 51%, according to the IEC.

The metros so far:
🏙️ Johannesburg: DA 36.5%, ANC 18.1%, ActionSA 17.9%
🏛️ Tshwane: DA 34.9%, ActionSA 23.8%, ANC 19.3%. The DA has moved into first place since this morning.
🏭 Ekurhuleni: DA 34.1%, ANC 19.9%, ActionSA 18.0%
🌊 Cape Town: DA 60.9%, ANC 10.7%
🌅 Nelson Mandela Bay: DA 40.3%, ANC 27.9%
🌴 eThekwini: MK 43.9%, DA 20.3%, ANC 18.3%. Very early: only 49 of 839 districts are in.

What it means for your pocket: so far, only Cape Town has a party above 50%. The Gauteng metros, Nelson Mandela Bay and eThekwini are heading for coalitions, and those deals will decide who sets your property rates, water and electricity tariffs and service budgets.

The numbers will still move. The IEC plans to announce the official results on Sunday, 8 November.
